item.title: ShikataLab - Backups: a Bucket, a Database Filesystem, and a Binlog Surprise
item.description: For a long time, my homelab backup strategy was “nothing here is irreplaceable,” which is a fine strategy right up until the day it isn’t. In my case the day came during a routine rebuild: a PersistentVolumeClaim got recreated, the volume underneath it went away with it, and my web analytics database — years of history — was just gone. Kubernetes defaults did exactly what they’re documented to do. The PVC had a Delete reclaim policy, the storage class agreed, and the data left.
